evals.prompt: Find coffee shops near Union Square in San Francisco and show them on a map.
evals.expected_output: Should search with category_search_tool or search_and_geocode_tool, then call render_map_tool with the search result's mapboxRender.ref in payload_refs, copied unchanged. Should not copy coordinates into markers or layers.
expectations: Passes the search result's mapboxRender.ref in payload_refs exactly as returned
Does not rebuild the places as hand-written markers or layers when a ref exists
Does not set camera (the map fits the data itself)

evals.prompt: Show me the driving route from Seattle to Portland and the gas stations along the way on one map.
evals.expected_output: Should get the route with directions_tool and the stations with category_search_tool, then make one render_map_tool call with both refs in payload_refs and a short summary.
expectations: Calls render_map_tool once, with both the directions ref and the search ref in payload_refs
Does not make one map per result
Any summary is short (about 40 characters or less)

evals.prompt: Make me a PNG map of downtown Chicago that I can paste into an email.
evals.expected_output: The user explicitly wants an image file, so static_map_image_tool is the right tool here, not render_map_tool.
expectations: Does not call render_map_tool for this request

evals.prompt: Show the restaurants you found near the Ferry Building on a map, but only the three with outdoor seating.
evals.expected_output: Should show a filtered subset as hand-placed markers, each with id set to the place's mapbox_id and name set to its name, instead of passing the full search ref.
expectations: Calls render_map_tool with markers for only the three chosen places
Sets each marker's id to the place's mapbox_id and name to its name
Does not pass the full search ref, which would show every result
